description: Print a page. Draw a picture and copy one word with a grown-up.

tier.name: Starting support
tier.range: Classroom support choice; not a WIDA proficiency level

A.studentGoal: I can draw and copy a word.

info.headline: I can draw and copy a word.
info.summary: Draw first; copy one word from the word bank.
canDo: I can draw and copy a word.

activities.title: Draw a Garden
activities.directions: Print your page. Draw a plant. Copy the word plant.
activities.directionsEs: Imprime tu página. Dibuja una planta. Copia la palabra plant.
activities.prompt: Draw a plant and copy the word.
activities.promptEs: Dibuja una planta y copia la palabra.
vocabulary: a green living thing that grows
planta: ser vivo verde que crece
to write the same thing you see
copiar: escribir lo mismo que ves
activities.correct: You drew and copied a word.
activities.hint: Use the sentence starter and the word bank. You can draw first, then write.
activities.support: Use the sentence starter and the word bank. You can draw first, then write.
activities.extension: Add a picture and one more sentence.
wida: Copy a word to label a drawing

teacher.use: With a grown-up beside the child. The grown-up may tap the speaker, point, and repeat; the child answers by pointing or saying a word.
teacher.lower: The child dictates and the adult writes; the child traces or copies one word.
teacher.onLevel: The child writes with the sentence starter and word bank.
teacher.challenge: Add a second sentence that tells why or what happened next.
teacher.noTech: This task is already on paper. Read the prompt aloud and point to the word bank.
teacher.prompt: Read your sentence to me. Which word bank word did you use?
